method: Manual review of regional fichas, relevant eBay galleries and expanded exact-title searches. Listing order is recorded when used; expanded search candidates are not claimed to have been reviewed in widget order. Shipping origin prioritizes discovery; edition and packaging region require coherent specimen photographs. Original bytes and source links retained. No automatic training or worker changes.
